gloss: removal from a register; expulsion from the rolls

definitions.explanation: The removal of a person's name from the koseki (family register), which occurs upon death, marriage into another family, or other legal changes in family status.
The removal of a person from an organization's register, such as being expelled from a school, dismissed from a military unit, or struck from a professional registry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{死亡|しぼう}→死亡：03198_shibou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{除籍|じょせき}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The name was removed from the family register due to death.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{除籍|じょせき}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When you marry, you are removed from your parents' family register.

examples.japanese: {除籍謄本|じょせきとうほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: A certified copy of a removed family register is often needed during inheritance procedures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不正行為|ふせいこうい}→不正行為：25084_fuseikoui⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{除籍|じょせき}になった。
examples.english: I was expelled from university for misconduct.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学費|がくひ}→学費：04706_gakuhi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{滞納|たいのう}→滞納：09323_tainou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{除籍|じょせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you fall behind on tuition, you may be removed from the student rolls.

examples.japanese: {党|とう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{背|そむ}いた→背く：19577_somuku⟧⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{除籍|じょせき}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: A lawmaker who defied the party's policy was expelled from the party rolls.

notes:
Compound of {除|じょ} (remove) and {籍|せき} (register; membership). The word's meaning depends heavily on context — in legal/administrative settings it refers to the ⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧ (family register) system, while in organizational contexts it means expulsion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {除籍|じょせき}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧: expulsion as a disciplinary action
- {除籍謄本|じょせきとうほん}: certified copy of a removed register
- {除籍|じょせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be removed from the rolls
- {党|とう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{除籍|じょせき}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be expelled from a political party

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{退学|たいがく}→退学：03387_taigaku⟧: withdrawal from school (may be voluntary)
- {除名|じょめい}: expulsion, specifically from an organization or group
- ⟦{抹消|まっしょう}→抹消：15522_masshou⟧: deletion, erasure from a record
